sixthsense.config.title: Sixth Sense Configuration
sixthsense.config.editor_help: Press H in game to open the HUD editor. Drag to move, scroll to resize, use Grid to align icons and Debug to preview animations. R resets the selected element; Shift+R resets all; Esc saves. Positions stay anchored to the nearest screen edge or center when the GUI scale changes.
sixthsense.editor.title: Sixth Sense HUD Editor
sixthsense.editor.help: Drag: move | Wheel: size | R: reset selected | Shift+R: reset all | Esc: save
sixthsense.editor.help_short: Drag | Wheel | R: reset | Shift+R: all | Esc: save
sixthsense.editor.debug_help: DEBUG PREVIEW - hover an element to play
sixthsense.editor.reset_body: Positions and sizes will return to their defaults.
sixthsense.editor.reload_images_failed: Could not reload %s. Previous images kept.
sixthsense.info.title: Feature checklist
sixthsense.info.bow:
Bow
- 24 blocks; visible armed monsters/players, either hand.
- 8 draw poses; holds full draw; count when more than one.
sixthsense.info.crossbow:
Crossbow
- 24 blocks; visible armed monsters/players, either hand.
- 8 charge poses; Quick Charge timing; loaded pose holds; count above one.
sixthsense.info.explosion:
Explosion
- 24 blocks; Creeper fuse (line of sight), primed TNT / TNT minecart (through walls).
- Fuse progress, explosion sequence; fastest fuse wins; quick fade.
sixthsense.info.ghast:
Ghast
- 64 blocks; visible charging/firing Ghasts and nearby fireballs.
- Floating tentacles; mouth opens for charge/fire and closes afterward.
- Optional distance (default on); excludes fireballs owned by you.
sixthsense.info.shulker:
Shulker
- Bullets within 24 blocks, including through walls; count above one.
- Shell-less head; elliptical orbit, spinning bullet, faint trail; occasional glances.
sixthsense.info.warden:
Warden
- 48 blocks, including through walls; closer means faster heartbeat.
- Sprinting keeps animation continuous; soft beat motion and compass rotation.
- Optional distance (default off); recent attacker / targeting Warden takes priority.
sixthsense.info.thorns:
Thorns
- No target: hidden. Targeting: smooth 1-second appearance.
- Warden hit: move inward and shrink 12%, then release.
- Blood tips intensify below 65% health; editable PNG.
- Singleplayer: exact target. Vanilla multiplayer: confirmed Warden hits only.
sixthsense.info.raid:
Raid
- Active raid: closest raider within 128 blocks; name, XYZ, compass, distance.
- Optional entity glow; locator dims when visible, stays strong behind walls.
- Automatic position below boss bars; fades after threats disappear.
sixthsense.info.layout:
Layout
- Automatic warning row; Warden stays centered, others move beside it.
- Custom positions stay independent; screen-edge/center anchors survive GUI changes.
- 3x GUI: 15% size boost; 4x unchanged; positions kept inside screen.
sixthsense.info.editor:
Editor (H)
- Drag: move; wheel: size (0.1–5); grid button / G: 8-unit snapping.
- R: selected reset; Shift+R: reset all with confirmation.
- Enter/Y: confirm; Esc/N: cancel confirmation; Esc: save and close.
sixthsense.info.debug:
Debug (D)
- Hover a card: animation; move away: still pose.
- Warden demo: heartbeat, compass, targeting, hit and low-health tips.
- Top-right reload; i: this checklist; Back returns to the editor.
sixthsense.info.reload:
Reload images
- Save PNG, then press reload; all 8 HUD textures refresh together.
- Priority: config/sixthsense/visuals/textures/gui, development source, active pack/mod.
- Invalid PNG/size: previous images kept; status shows failure.
- HUD PNGs only: no code, settings, language, sound or world reload.
sixthsense.info.settings:
Settings
- Per-warning toggles; raid glow; Ghast/Warden distance; X/Y/size.
- Mod Menu + Cloth Config, or config/sixthsense.json; -1 position = automatic.
- Settings persist; old positions migrate to anchors.
sixthsense.info.language:
Language
- Follows Minecraft: English, Chinese, Hindi, Spanish, Arabic, Turkish, Azerbaijani.
- Unsupported languages / missing translations fall back to English.
sixthsense.info.general:
General
- Numpad 0: HUD on/off + status message; H and toggle can be rebound.
- Client-side; alerts use client-visible entities, not guaranteed hostile targeting.
- Normal alerts fade within 3 seconds; explosion within 0.25 seconds.
- World changes clear old threats; original explosion/heart art preserved.
